snippet.title: My Pet Hooligan | Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Are you ready to defy the evil overlord MetaZuckBot and unleash mayhem upon the streets of Hooliland City?

Discover the crazy world of My Pet Hooligan in our Early Access Gameplay Trailer, offering a sneak peek into this upcoming multiplayer knockout. 

During this Early Access phase, you'll engage in epic battles across two early game modes, including Anarchy (Free-For-All) and Coinpocalypse, with more to come. You'll also being able to explore some of the wider environments and get a taste of what’s to come. 

Whether you prefer engaging in fierce combat, wreaking havoc on the environment, showcasing your skateboarding skills like a pro, leaving your mark with graffiti on buildings, or simply chilling with friends, being a Hooligan means playing the way you want!

Dive into the chaos soon and join our community now!

Website: https://mypethooligan.com/
X: https://twitter.com/mypethooligan
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mypethooligan/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mypethooligan
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mypethooligan
Play for Free: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/my-pet-hooligan-453949

Don't miss out on the fun – Gently make love to the Subscribe button and dive into the My Pet Hooligan universe now!

ESRB RATING: Teen with Crude Humour, Drug Reference and Fantasy Violence.

#mypethooligan #freetoplay #multiplayer #mph
